age_limit.details: Upper age limit: 25 years as on 26-08-2026 Age relaxation of 5 years for SC candidates against reserved vacancies Age relaxation up to 35 years (40 years for SC) for widows, divorced women, and women judicially separated from husbands, subject to documentary proof Age relaxation for Ex-Servicemen as per Government of India rules OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) and EWS candidates are not entitled to any age relaxation and must apply under the General (Unreserved) category ST candidates are not entitled to age relaxation but can avail a fee waiver by selecting the ST category and uploading their caste certificate

qualification.details: Candidates must have passed SSC/10th Standard from a recognized Board, Institution, or University. Any other qualification recognized as equivalent will also be considered.

salary_details.details: The post of Multi-Tasking Staff carries Pay Level-1 of the 7th CPC (Rs. 18,000-56,900). Selected candidates are also entitled to usual allowances such as Dearness Allowance (DA) and Transport Allowance (TA) as per CSIR/Government of India rules.

content_sections.heading: CSIR IGIB Multi-Tasking Staff Vacancy 2026 Out
content_sections.text: CSIR IGIB has announced total of 2 vacancies for the post of Multi-Tasking Staff, distributed across categories as below. The number of vacancies is provisional and may vary at the time of selection, as per the notification.

content_sections.heading: CSIR IGIB MTS Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility for the post of Multi-Tasking Staff is assessed as on the last date of online application, i.e., 26-08-2026.

rows.details: SSC/10th Standard (or an equivalent recognized qualification)

content_sections.heading: CSIR IGIB MTS Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: Candidates must have passed SSC/10th Standard from a recognized Board, Institution, or University. Any other qualification recognized as equivalent will also be considered.

content_sections.heading: CSIR IGIB MTS Age Limit and Relaxation 2026
content_sections.text: Upper age limit: 25 years as on 26-08-2026 Age relaxation of 5 years for SC candidates against reserved vacancies Age relaxation up to 35 years (40 years for SC) for widows, divorced women, and women judicially separated from husbands, subject to documentary proof Age relaxation for Ex-Servicemen as per Government of India rules OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) and EWS candidates are not entitled to any age relaxation and must apply under the General (Unreserved) category ST candidates are not entitled to age relaxation but can avail a fee waiver by selecting the ST category and uploading their caste certificate

content_sections.heading: CSIR IGIB MTS 2026 Salary Structure
content_sections.text: The post of Multi-Tasking Staff carries Pay Level-1 of the 7th CPC (Rs. 18,000-56,900). The approximate gross emoluments are Rs. 36,360/- per month, based on the minimum of the scale including HRA applicable to Delhi. Selected candidates are also entitled to usual allowances such as Dearness Allowance (DA) and Transport Allowance (TA) as per CSIR/Government of India rules.

content_sections.heading: CSIR IGIB Multi-Tasking Staff Application Fee 2026
content_sections.text: The application fee is non-refundable and must be paid through SBI Collect. A copy of the SBI Collect e-receipt must be uploaded along with the online application.

content_sections.heading: CSIR IGIB MTS Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made through a single-stage OMR Based Objective Type Multiple Choice Examination. Total Questions: 100 | Total Duration: 1 hour 30 minutes Questions will be set in both English and Hindi, except for the English Language section The final merit list will be prepared based on marks obtained in this single paper

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for CSIR IGIB MTS Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Visit the official website: https://www.igib.res.in Go to "Opportunities → Permanent Position Open" Click on "Multi-Tasking Staff Advt. 2026" Click the "Apply Here" link to register and fill the online application Upload photograph, signature, and required documents Pay the application fee (if applicable) via SBI Collect and upload the e-receipt Submit the form and retain a printout for future reference

content_sections.heading: CSIR IGIB MTS Required Documents 2026
content_sections.text: Recent passport-size color photograph Signature of the candidate Matriculation/10th certificate indicating Date of Birth Copy of essential educational qualification certificate Copy of other educational qualification certificates, if any SC certificate in prescribed GoI format, if applicable Proof of Ex-Servicemen status, if applicable SBI Collect e-receipt for application fee, wherever applicable No Objection Certificate (NOC), if currently employed in CSIR/Government/PSU/Autonomous Body

content_sections.heading: CSIR IGIB MTS Recruitment 2026 Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Only one application per candidate will be accepted; the latest completed application will be considered if multiple are submitted Applications submitted cannot be withdrawn, and the fee is non-refundable Once submitted, no modification to the application will be allowed Selected candidates will be on probation for two years All posts carry All India Service Liability (AISL) No separate call letters or individual communication will be sent; candidates must check the website regularly Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification Candidates who have completed their 10th standard can also explore more 10th Pass Government Jobs and Multi-Tasking Staff Jobs available across India. Applicants looking for more opportunities in Delhi can also check Delhi Government Jobs for upcoming vacancies. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CSIR IGIB MTS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 26-08-2026 up to 05:00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CSIR IGIB MTS Recruitment 2026?
Q3. What is the educational qualification required for CSIR IGIB MTS?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed SSC/10th Standard or an equivalent recognized qualification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for CSIR IGIB MTS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 25 years as on 26-08-2026, with relaxation as applicable per rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for CSIR IGIB MTS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 500/-. SC, ST, Women, PwBD, and Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of CSIR IGIB Multi-Tasking Staff?
faq.answer: The post carries Pay Level-1 (Rs. 18,000-56,900), with approximate gross emoluments of Rs. 36,360/- including Delhi HRA.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for CSIR IGIB MTS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through a single-stage OMR Based Objective Type Multiple Choice Examination covering General Intelligence, Quantitative Aptitude, General Awareness, and English Language.

faq.question: Q8. Is there negative marking in the CSIR IGIB MTS exam?
faq.answer: Yes, one mark is deducted for every wrong answer in each subject.

faq.question: Q9. What is the probation period for CSIR IGIB MTS post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be on probation for a period of two years from the date of taking charge.
